HelpText[9].SourceString: Hold Spacebar to glide across wide gaps
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Hold Spacebar to glide across wide gaps

HelpText[9].SourceString: To cross wide gaps, use a combination of jump, dash and feathering the glider on and off
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: To cross wide gaps, use a combination of jump, dash and feathering the glider on and off

HelpText[9].SourceString: SECRET TIP: When Mantling out of the Abyss, simply move against the cliff. Don't press the Jump key: this will bring your glider out, making it possible to spike you.
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: SECRET TIP: When Mantling out of the Abyss, simply move against the cliff. Don't press the Jump key: this will bring your glider out, making it possible to spike you.

HelpText[9].SourceString: Traversal Challenge
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Traversal Challenge

HelpText[9].SourceString: Pilot the Skyshark over the Abyss to the Objective Marker
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Pilot the Skyshark over the Abyss to the Objective Marker

HelpText[9].SourceString: Fall into the Abyss, then rise back up with your glider to collect the Low-Altitude Orbs
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Fall into the Abyss, then rise back up with your glider to collect the Low-Altitude Orbs

HelpText[9].SourceString: Glide through Wind Rings to travel quickly
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Glide through Wind Rings to travel quickly

HelpText[9].SourceString: Cross the gap without being spiked by releasing glide before taking damage
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Cross the gap without being spiked by releasing glide before taking damage

HelpText[9].SourceString: Feather glider on and off to fly further before overheating
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Feather glider on and off to fly further before overheating

HelpText[9].SourceString: Press E to mount a Skyshark, WASD to strafe, and hold Spacebar to accelerate toward your cursor
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Press E to mount a Skyshark, WASD to strafe, and hold Spacebar to accelerate toward your cursor

HelpText[9].SourceString: Plan carefully: Skysharks have limited fuel
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Plan carefully: Skysharks have limited fuel

HelpText[9].SourceString: Warning: Skysharks explode when they take too much damage or run out of fuel
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Warning: Skysharks explode when they take too much damage or run out of fuel

HelpText[9].SourceString: Spike enemies by damaging them while they're gliding until they Overheat.
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Spike enemies by damaging them while they're gliding until they Overheat.

HelpText[9].SourceString: Avoid Being Spiked: Collect all of the orbs without getting spiked
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Avoid Being Spiked: Collect all of the orbs without getting spiked

HelpText[9].SourceString: Avoid Being Spiked Challenge
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Avoid Being Spiked Challenge

HelpText[9].SourceString: Spike Enemies Challenge
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Spike Enemies Challenge

HelpText[9].SourceString: Taking damage while gliding adds Heat. Taking damage while Overheated will Spike you.
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Taking damage while gliding adds Heat. Taking damage while Overheated will Spike you.

HelpText[9].SourceString: Don't be afraid to fall a certain distance into the Abyss. Your glider can always bring you back up.
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Don't be afraid to fall a certain distance into the Abyss. Your glider can always bring you back up.

HelpText[9].SourceString: Gliding too long will Overheat your glider, causing burn damage over time. Stand on solid ground to reduce heat.
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Gliding too long will Overheat your glider, causing burn damage over time. Stand on solid ground to reduce heat.

HelpText[9].SourceString: Boss Challenge
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Boss Challenge

HelpText[9].SourceString: Step into the circle to respawn boss
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Step into the circle to respawn boss

HelpText[9].SourceString: Interact with the Vault to begin picking the lock
HelpText[9].LocalizedString: Interact with the Vault to begin picking the lock
